name: com.pg.buffs
description: Timed effects on a character: Buff base class, BuffManager, BuffLinker, BuffData, the active effects bar, poison and regeneration. Other effects (fire, cold, heat) are your own Buff subclasses registered with CheckBuffType.Register. Needs com.pg.health-system and com.pg.menu.
author: Lucia Lunadottir

samples.description: A custom Buff and its registration with CheckBuffType.Register. After import remove the .txt from the file name.
